rationale: Runner lost communication during checkout indicates CI runner infrastructure failure.
AssertionError in test suite indicates regression or code bug.
Intermittent network socket timeout passing on rerun is classic flaky test.
Job exceeded maximum execution time and killed by system is job timeout.
Root cause is TypeScript syntax error in codebase, despite npm 404 in tail log.
Truncated log without stack trace cannot be deterministically classified; requires human review.
DNS resolution failure to package archive is infrastructure/network issue.
TypeError reading properties of undefined is application code exception.
Exit code 137 indicates OOM killer or SIGKILL by runner environment; borderline case.
User cancellation is external workflow abort, not code defect.
